checkedAlternates.risk: Groundwater discharge is underground like infiltration.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Infiltration is water entering soil from the surface (group-1), whereas groundwater discharge flows out toward streams and oceans (group-4).
Snowmelt streams are liquid surface runoff (group-4), not falling precipitation.
